headline: Through 10 Nov, fuel commission is ahead of the $9,500 pace
bullets: Sales for 1–10 Nov are $167,270.80: fuel $97,937.60 and shop $69,333.20.
Shop gross profit on covered sales is $24,719.74 (43.5%). Costs are provisional and coverage is not complete.
Fuel commission is $5,595.75, 58.9% of the $9,500 November target with 10 days loaded.
At the current daily average, commission would finish near $16,787. That run-rate is not a promise.
